blocks.text:
With this breath stuck in my chest
Walls lean in, I second-guess
Justice knocking, knuckles white
Decency begging me not to fight

I stand between the yes and no
Every answer draws its blood
If I move I bruise the bone
If I stay I hurt my gut

They say choose like it’s a cure
Like clean hands mean you’re pure

Don’t need permission to ache
Don’t dress it up, don’t make it safe
I’m choosing what part of me breaks
Just to stay awake

We learned to smile through the grind
Call the numbness “being kind”
Silence sold as higher ground
Every bruise tucked neatly down

I don’t want your painless truth
I don’t want this curated lie
I just want to name the wound
Before it eats me alive

No ground below, no sky above
Just gravity and stubborn love

Don’t need permission to ache
Let it sting, let it shake
I’ll take the mark / I’ll take the weight
Just don’t ask me to look away

If this is what conscience costs
I’ll pay it in sleep I’ve lost
Don’t call me calm
If I’m just quiet

Don’t need permission to ache
I’m not numb, I’m not late
I’m still here in the wake
Of the choices we don’t escape
I don’t need permission to ache

If there’s nowhere clear to land
I’ll hover…
as long as I can

notebook.style: Mid-tempo (75–85 BPM), Crisp theatrical vocals with dry, deadpan delivery under constant physical tension, Predominantly spoken-sung with narrow pitch range; confident, declarative, and intentionally uncomfortable, Perfect diction, Voice should sound like breath is trapped in the chest—phrases cut short, inhales audible, sustained notes avoided as if singing would tip into a scream, Annunciation is sharp and exposed: crisp consonants, clipped endings, controlled vowels, Timing and phrasing carry meaning more than melody; allow slight rush or drag to heighten strain, Avoid warmth, pleading, or melodic bloom, Verses conversational but taut; choruses chant-adjacent, rigid, and denied—never triumphant, Instrumentation tight and abrasive: dry drum hits, forward bass, clean guitars with edge, Percussive horn stabs punctuate phrases like punctuation, not hooks, Wurlitzer keys percussive and brittle; light acid-jazz elements add nervous energy without smoothing, Use silence intentionally
